entries.description: Sets the voltage level at which an Overvoltage condition is signaled and the controller must turn off its power stage.
This voltage gets subtracted to the Overvoltage limit to set the voltage at which the overvoltage condition will be cleared.
Below this voltage the controller will turn off its power stage until voltage rises above the limit. Enter the desired value multiplied by 10.
